Ticket 002-negative-quantity:

# 002: Cart accepts negative quantities

Cart.add("apple", -1) quietly lowers the line. Anything below zero should raise ValueError("quantity must be positive") and leave the cart unchanged. Failing test: tests/test_cart.py::test_add_negative_quantity_rejected. Acceptance: `pytest --runxfail tests/test_cart.py::test_add_negative_quantity_rejected -q` passes, the rest of the suite still passes, and no test file is edited.
Cart.add only rejects zero. I'll reject everything below one.
